description: This Dart source file defines the TransactionsProvider class, a state management class implementing ChangeNotifier for a Flutter application. It manages a list of transaction models, supports filtering (by type and date range), and performs CRUD operations via a transaction repository. It also handles in-memory caching and communicates with category data to filter by transaction type.

classes.name: TransactionsProvider
classes.description: A ChangeNotifier class that manages a list of transaction models with filtering capabilities, and integrates with repositories for persistent storage and category data.

methods.name: loadRecent
methods.description: Loads recent transactions from the repository, applying current filters.

methods.name: setKindFilter
methods.description: Sets the transaction type filter (all, income, expense) and reloads transactions.

methods.name: setRange
methods.description: Sets the date range filter and reloads transactions.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new transaction, updates cache and UI optimistically.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing transaction in the repository and cache.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a transaction by ID from the repository and cache.

methods.name: _applyKindFilter
methods.description: Internal method to filter a list of transactions based on the current kind filter.

methods.name: _matchesCurrentFilters
methods.description: Checks if a transaction matches the current date range and kind filters.
